repository.description: Saleor Core: the high performance, composable, headless commerce API.

key_features: Real-Time Inventory Management with Multi-Warehouse Support

user_stories.title: Multi-Channel Product Catalog Management
user_stories.description: As a merchant, I want to manage my product catalog across multiple sales channels (online store, mobile app, marketplace) so that I can maintain consistent product information while customizing availability, pricing, and content for different customer segments and markets.
acceptance_criteria: I can create product types with custom attributes and variants (size, color, material) through the GraphQL API
I can set channel-specific pricing, availability, and product descriptions for different storefronts
I can bulk import/export product data via CSV with validation and error reporting
I can organize products into hierarchical categories and collections with SEO-optimized URLs
I can manage product media (images, videos) with automatic optimization and CDN integration

user_stories.title: Seamless Multi-Step Checkout Experience
user_stories.description: As a customer, I want a smooth, secure checkout process that works across all devices and supports guest checkout, so that I can complete my purchase quickly without friction, whether I'm a returning customer or first-time buyer.
acceptance_criteria: I can complete checkout as a guest without creating an account, with option to register after purchase
I can save multiple shipping and billing addresses for future use with address validation
I can apply discount codes and see real-time price calculations including taxes and shipping
I can choose from multiple payment methods (credit card, digital wallets, BNPL) with secure tokenization
I receive immediate order confirmation with tracking information and can view order status in real-time

user_stories.title: Advanced Order Management and Fulfillment
user_stories.description: As a merchant, I want comprehensive order management capabilities so that I can efficiently process orders from multiple channels, handle partial fulfillments, manage returns, and provide excellent customer service throughout the order lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: I can view and manage orders from all channels in a unified interface with filtering and search capabilities
I can process partial fulfillments and track inventory allocation across multiple warehouses
I can handle returns and refunds with automatic inventory updates and customer notifications
I can add internal notes and communicate with customers through order-specific messaging
I can generate shipping labels and tracking numbers with integration to shipping providers

user_stories.title: Real-Time Inventory Management with Multi-Warehouse Support
user_stories.description: As an operations manager, I want real-time inventory tracking across multiple warehouses and sales channels so that I can prevent overselling, optimize stock levels, and ensure accurate product availability for customers.
acceptance_criteria: I can track real-time stock levels across multiple warehouses with automatic reservation during checkout
I can set up intelligent stock allocation rules based on customer location and warehouse capacity
I can receive automated alerts for low stock levels and configure reorder points for products
I can view inventory analytics including stock turnover, dead stock identification, and demand forecasting
I can handle stock transfers between warehouses with audit trails and approval workflows

user_stories.title: Flexible Promotion and Discount Engine
user_stories.description: As a marketing manager, I want to create and manage complex promotional campaigns with various discount types and conditions so that I can drive sales, reward loyal customers, and optimize conversion rates across different customer segments.
acceptance_criteria: I can create vouchers with percentage, fixed amount, and free shipping discounts with usage limits
I can set conditional discounts based on cart value, specific products, customer groups, or purchase history
I can schedule time-limited promotions with automatic activation and deactivation
I can create gift cards with custom values and track redemption across all channels
I can analyze promotion performance with detailed reports on usage, revenue impact, and customer behavior

user_stories.title: Comprehensive Customer Account Management
user_stories.description: As a customer, I want a personalized account experience where I can manage my profile, track orders, save preferences, and access my purchase history so that I can have a tailored shopping experience and easily reorder products I love.
acceptance_criteria: I can register and log in using email/password or social media accounts with secure authentication
I can manage multiple shipping and billing addresses with nickname labels for easy selection
I can view detailed order history with status tracking, invoices, and reorder functionality
I can save favorite products to wishlists and receive notifications for price changes or restocks
I can update my preferences for communications, newsletters, and personalized recommendations

user_stories.title: Developer-Friendly GraphQL API Integration
user_stories.description: As a frontend developer, I want a well-documented, type-safe GraphQL API with comprehensive tooling so that I can quickly build custom storefronts, mobile apps, and integrations while maintaining consistent data access patterns.
acceptance_criteria: I can access comprehensive GraphQL schema documentation with examples and playground interface
I can use strongly-typed queries and mutations with automatic code generation for my chosen frontend framework
I can implement real-time features using webhooks for order updates, stock changes, and customer actions
I can authenticate API requests using JWT tokens with proper permission scoping for different user types
I can test API interactions in a sandbox environment with sample data and comprehensive error handling

user_stories.title: Advanced Analytics and Reporting Dashboard
user_stories.description: As a business owner, I want comprehensive analytics and reporting capabilities so that I can make data-driven decisions about my business, understand customer behavior, track performance metrics, and identify growth opportunities.
acceptance_criteria: I can view real-time sales dashboards with revenue, orders, and conversion metrics across all channels
I can analyze customer behavior including acquisition sources, lifetime value, and purchase patterns
I can generate detailed product performance reports showing best sellers, inventory turnover, and profit margins
I can track marketing campaign effectiveness with attribution modeling and ROI calculations
I can export custom reports in multiple formats (CSV, PDF) and schedule automated report delivery
